breakdown.description: Inviscid simulation requested but top wall uses noSlip; inviscid wall should not impose no-slip viscous condition
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification correctly identifies the simulation as 'inviscid' and sets viscosity to 0. However, it then incorrectly applies a 'no-slip' boundary condition to the top wall. A no-slip condition is a viscous boundary condition and contradicts the inviscid nature of the flow. The agent should have corrected this to a 'slip' condition.
